verdict.rationale: Release changelog generation is a fair question for a work-management platform that tracks engineering work, so the axis applies. The evidence pack never documents auto-generating a changelog or release notes per release. Nearby items do not count. Linking GitHub/GitLab pull requests to items is a different feature. Scheduled status and performance reports are a related but separate capability. Custom agents, the API and automations are building blocks a user could assemble, not the capability itself.
